name: (NEW MAP) HEAT [FPS]
desc:
⭐ FEATURES

🔫 Custom weapon loadouts
🪖 Operators and character customization
🎨 Weapon camos, mastery challenges, and unlocks
📦 Cases with multiple rarities and exclusive rewards
🔑 Earn Keys through gameplay and use them to open cases
🏆 XP, leveling, medals, challenges, and progression
💥 Scorestreaks and fast-paced gunfights
⚔️ Duels and competitive modes
🗺️ Multiple maps and game modes
🎮 Keyboard and controller support
👥 Party up and play with friends
🧟 Zombies coming soon

Play matches, complete challenges, earn Keys, unlock cases, and grind your way toward the rarest rewards and mastery camos.

🔥 UPDATED WEEKLY
HEAT is in active development, with new weapons, cosmetics, maps, modes, balance changes, and features being added regularly.

⚠️ EARLY ACCESS
HEAT is still in early development. Some content may be unfinished, unbalanced, changed, or occasionally buggy while we continue improving the game.
